question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Resilient
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Strong.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"resilient"** means able to withstand or recover quickly from difficult conditions. (लचीला)

 
 
• **Example:** After facing numerous challenges, the community remained resilient and rebuilt their lives.
 
 
 
• **"Strong" **refers to having the power to move heavy weights or perform other physically demanding tasks; having the ability to withstand or endure. (मजबूत)
 
 
• **Example:** The bridge is strong enough to support the weight of several vehicles at once.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'resilient' **is **'strong'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Strong**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Content** (संतुष्ट): In a state of peaceful happiness.

 
 
• **Example:** She felt content after completing her project successfully.
 
 
 
• **Coarse** (अशिष्ट): Rough or harsh in texture.
 
 
• **Example:** The coarse fabric was uncomfortable to wear.
 
 
 
• **Antique** (पुराना): A collectible object that has a high value because of its age and quality.
 
 
• **Example:** The antique clock in the living room has been passed down through generations.
